description: This file defines the internal class GrainDirectoryHandoffManager, which manages handoff operations for grain directories during silo additions and removals in Orleans. It handles partition splitting, registration acceptance, duplicate activations, and operation queuing with retries, utilizing async programming patterns and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryHandoffManager
classes.description: Manages silo join/leave handoff for grain directories, including partition splitting and duplicate detection, with queued asynchronous operations and retries.

methods.name: ProcessSiloAddEvent
methods.description: Handles a silo addition event by determining if the added silo is an immediate successor and if so, performs partition splitting and sends partition segments.

methods.name: ProcessAddedSiloAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the addition of a silo, accepting split partitions and removing corresponding entries, if the silo is active.

methods.name: AcceptExistingRegistrations
methods.description: Enqueues registration acceptance operations for a list of grain addresses.

methods.name: AcceptExistingRegistrationsAsync
methods.description: Registers a list of grain addresses asynchronously and handles duplicate activations.

methods.name: DestroyDuplicateActivations
methods.description: Enqueues the destruction of duplicate activations on different silos.

methods.name: DestroyDuplicateActivationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously destroys duplicate grain activations on specified silos.

methods.name: EnqueueOperation
methods.description: Adds an asynchronous operation to the pending operations queue and triggers execution if queue length is below threshold.

methods.name: ExecutePendingOperations
methods.description: Executes queued operations with retry logic and concurrency control.
